## 🎓 Reviewer Guidelines
Areas that need special attention:

- [ ] **Concurrency correctness**: Race conditions, deadlocks, memory ordering
- [ ] **Performance validity**: Benchmark measures what it claims to measure
- [ ] **Educational clarity**: Concepts explained clearly with good analogies
- [ ] **Code safety**: Memory leaks, undefined behavior, resource cleanup
- [ ] **Reproducibility**: Results consistent across different runs/systems

- **Validation**: [e.g., tested on 3 different systems with consistent results]
